تعتاضي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَاضِي (taʕtāḍī) /taʕ.taː.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# تُعْتَاضِي (tuʕtāḍī) /tuʕ.taː.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
